classes.name: StepData_EnumTool
classes.summary:
This class gives a way of conversion between the value of an enumeration and its representation in STEP An enumeration corresponds to an integer with reserved values, which begin to 0 In STEP, it is represented by a name in capital letter and limited by two dots, e.g. .UNKNOWN.
EnumTool works with integers, it is just required to cast between an integer and an enumeration of required type.
Its definition is intended to allow static creation in once, without having to recreate once for each use.
It is possible to define subclasses on it, which directly give the good list of definition texts, and accepts a enumeration of the good type instead of an integer

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.signature: (e0?: string, e1?: string, e2?: string, e3?: string, e4?: string, e5?: string, e6?: string, e7?: string, e8?: string, e9?: string, e10?: string, e11?: string, e12?: string, e13?: string, e14?: string, e15?: string, e16?: string, e17?: string, e18?: string, e19?: string, e20?: string, e21?: string, e22?: string, e23?: string, e24?: string, e25?: string, e26?: string, e27?: string, e28?: string, e29?: string, e30?: string, e31?: string, e32?: string, e33?: string, e34?: string, e35?: string, e36?: string, e37?: string, e38?: string, e39?: string)
constructors.comment:
Creates an EnumTool with definitions given by e0 .. e<max> Each definition string can bring one term, or several separated by blanks. Each term corresponds to one value of the enumeration, if dots are not presents they are added.
Such a static constructor allows to build a static description as : static {@link StepData_EnumTool | `StepData_EnumTool`} myenumtool("e0","e1"...); then use it without having to initialise it
A null definition can be input by given "$" :the corresponding position is attached to "null/undefined" value (as one particular item of the enumeration list)

instanceMethods.name: AddDefinition
instanceMethods.comment: Processes a definition, splits it according blanks if any empty definitions are ignored A null definition can be input by given "$" :the corresponding position is attached to "null/undefined" value (as one particular item of the enumeration list) See also IsSet.

instanceMethods.name: IsSet
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns True if at least one definition has been entered after creation time (i.e. by AddDefinition only).
This allows to build a static description by a first pass : static {@link StepData_EnumTool | `StepData_EnumTool`} myenumtool("e0" ...); ... if (!myenumtool.`IsSet()`) { for further inits myenumtool.AddDefinition("e21"); ... }

instanceMethods.name: MaxValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the maximum integer for a suitable value Remark : while values begin at zero, MaxValue is the count of recorded values minus one.

instanceMethods.name: Optional
instanceMethods.comment: Sets or Unsets the EnumTool to accept undefined value (for optional field). Ignored if no null value is defined (by "$") Can be changed during execution (to read each field), Default is True (if a null value is defined).

instanceMethods.name: NullValue
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value attached to "null/undefined value" If none is specified or if Optional has been set to False, returns -1 Null Value has been specified by definition "$".

instanceMethods.name: Text
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the text which corresponds to a given numeric value It is limited by dots If num is out of range, returns an empty string.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the numeric value found for a text The text must be in capitals and limited by dots A non-suitable text gives a negative value to be returned.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Same as above but works on an AsciiString.

classes.name: StepData_Field
classes.summary:
Defines a generally defined Field for STEP data : can be used either in any kind of entity to implement it or in free format entities in a "late-binding" mode A field can have : no value (or derived), a single value of any kind, a list of value : single or double list.
When a field is set, this defines its new kind (Integer etc..) A single value is immediately set. A list of value is, firstly declared as for a kind (Integer String etc), then declared as a list with its initial size, after this its items are set Also it can be set in once if the HArray is ready

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a Field, empty ("no value defined").

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a Field from another one. If <copy> is True, Handled data (Select,String,List, not entities) are copied.

instanceMethods.name: CopyFrom
instanceMethods.comment: Gets the copy of the values of another field.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears the field, to set it as "no value defined" Just before SetList, predeclares it as "any" A Kind can be directly set here to declare a type.

instanceMethods.name: SetDerived
instanceMethods.comment: Codes a Field as derived (no proper value).

instanceMethods.name: SetInt
instanceMethods.comment: Directly sets the Integer value, if its Kind matches Integer, Boolean, Logical, or Enum (does not change Kind).

instanceMethods.name: SetInt
instanceMethods.signature: (num: number, val: number, kind: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Internal access to an Integer Value for a list, plus its kind.

instanceMethods.name: SetInteger
instanceMethods.comment: Sets an Integer value (before SetList* declares it as Integer).

instanceMethods.name: SetInteger

instanceMethods.name: SetBoolean
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a Boolean value (or predeclares a list as boolean).

instanceMethods.name: SetLogical
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a Logical Value (or predeclares a list as logical).

instanceMethods.name: SetReal
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a Real Value (or predeclares a list as Real);.

instanceMethods.name: SetString
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a String Value (or predeclares a list as String) Does not redefine the Kind if it is already String or Enum.

instanceMethods.name: SetEnum
instanceMethods.comment: Sets an Enum Value (as its integer counterpart) (or predeclares a list as Enum) If <text> is given , also sets its textual expression <val> negative means unknown (known values begin at 0).

instanceMethods.name: SetEnum
instanceMethods.signature: (num: number, val: number, text: string): void
instanceMethods.comment: Sets an Enum Value (Integer counterpart), also its text expression if known (if list has been set as "any").

instanceMethods.name: SetSelectMember
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a SelectMember (for Integer,Boolean,Enum,Real,Logical) Hence, the value of the field is accessed through this member.

instanceMethods.name: SetEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Sets an Entity Value.

instanceMethods.name: SetEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Predeclares a list as of entity.

instanceMethods.name: SetList
instanceMethods.comment: Declares a field as a list, with an initial size Initial lower is defaulted as 1, can be defined The list starts empty, typed by the last Set* If no Set* before, sets it as "any" (transient/select).

instanceMethods.name: SetList2
instanceMethods.signature: (siz1: number, siz2: number, f1?: number, f2?: number): void
instanceMethods.comment: Declares a field as an homogeneous square list, with initial sizes, and initial lowers.

instanceMethods.name: Set
instanceMethods.comment: Sets an undetermined value : can be String, SelectMember, HArray(1-2) ... else, an Entity In case of an HArray, determines and records its size(s).

instanceMethods.name: ClearItem
instanceMethods.comment: Declares an item of the list as undefined (ignored if list not defined as String,Entity or Any).

instanceMethods.name: ItemKind
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the kind of an item in a list or double list It is the kind of the list, except if it is "Any", in such a case the true kind is determined and returned.

instanceMethods.name: Kind
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the kind of the field <type> True (D) : returns only the type itself else, returns the complete kind.

classes.name: StepData_FileProtocol
classes.summary: A FileProtocol is defined as the addition of several already existing Protocols. It corresponds to the definition of a SchemaName with several Names, each one being attached to a specific Protocol. Thus, a File defined with a compound Schema is processed as any other one, once built the equivalent compound Protocol, a FileProtocol.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an empty FileProtocol.

instanceMethods.name: NbResources
instanceMethods.comment: Gives the count of Protocols used as Resource (can be zero) i.e. the count of Protocol recorded by calling the method Add.

instanceMethods.name: Resource
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Resource, given a rank. Here, rank of calling Add.

instanceMethods.name: TypeNumber
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Case Number, specific of each recognized Type Here, NO Type at all is recognized properly : all Types are recognized by the resources.

instanceMethods.name: SchemaName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Schema Name attached to each class of Protocol To be redefined by each sub-class Here, SchemaName returns "" (empty String) was C++ : return const.

instanceMethods.name: Evaluate
instanceMethods.signature: (akey: TCollection_AsciiString): { returnValue: boolean; res: Standard_Transient; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Evaluates if recognition has a result, returns it if yes In case of success, Returns True and puts result in "res" In case of Failure, simply Returns False Works by calling deferred method Eval, and in case of failure, looks for Added Recognizers to work.
@returns A result object with fields:
- `returnValue`: the C++ return value
- `res`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: Result
instanceMethods.comment: Returns result of last recognition (call of Evaluate).

instanceMethods.name: Add
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a new Recognizer to the Compound, at the end Several calls to Add work by adding in the order of calls : Hence, when Eval has failed to recognize, Evaluate will call Evaluate from the first added Recognizer if there is one, and to the second if there is still no result, and so on.

constructors.name: constructor

instanceMethods.name: Add

instanceMethods.name: Module
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Module stored in a given GlobalNode.

instanceMethods.name: Protocol
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the attached Protocol stored in a given GlobalNode.

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Next GlobalNode. If none is defined, returned value is a Null Handle.

constructors.name: constructor

instanceMethods.name: AddNode
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a couple (Module,Protocol), that is, stores it into itself if not yet done, else creates a Next Node to do it.

instanceMethods.name: Module
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Module designated by a precise Node.

instanceMethods.name: Protocol
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Protocol designated by a precise Node.

instanceMethods.name: Next

classes.name: StepData_PDescr
classes.summary:
This class is intended to describe the authorized form for a parameter, as a type or a value for a field.
A PDescr firstly describes a type, which can be SELECT, i.e. have several members

instanceMethods.name: SetSelect
instanceMethods.comment: Declares this PDescr to be a Select, hence to have members <me> itself can be the first member.

instanceMethods.name: AddMember
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a member to a SELECT description.

instanceMethods.name: SetMemberName
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a name for SELECT member. To be used if a member is for an immediate type.

instanceMethods.name: SetInteger
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for an Integer value.

instanceMethods.name: SetReal
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for a Real value.

instanceMethods.name: SetString
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for a String value.

instanceMethods.name: SetBoolean
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for a Boolean value (false,true).

instanceMethods.name: SetLogical
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for a Logical value (false,true,unknown).

instanceMethods.name: SetEnum
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for an Enum value Then, call AddEnumDef ordered from the first one (value 0).

instanceMethods.name: AddEnumDef
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an enum value as a string.

instanceMethods.name: SetType
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for an Entity which must match a Type (early-bound).

instanceMethods.name: SetDescr
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> for a Described Entity, whose Description must match the type name <dscnam>.

instanceMethods.name: AddArity
instanceMethods.comment: Adds an arity count to <me>, by default 1 1 : a simple field passes to a LIST/ARRAY etc or a LIST to a LIST OF LIST 2 : a simple field passes to a LIST OF LIST.

instanceMethods.name: SetArity
instanceMethods.comment: Directly sets the arity count 0 : simple field 1 : LIST or ARRAY etc 2 : LIST OF LIST.

instanceMethods.name: SetFrom
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> as <other> but duplicated Hence, some definition may be changed.

instanceMethods.name: SetOptional
instanceMethods.comment: Sets/Unsets <me> to accept undefined values.

instanceMethods.name: SetDerived
instanceMethods.comment: Sets/Unsets <me> to be for a derived field.

instanceMethods.name: SetField
instanceMethods.comment: Sets <me> to describe a field of an entity With a name and a rank.

instanceMethods.name: IsSelect
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for a SELECT.

instanceMethods.name: Member
instanceMethods.comment:
For a SELECT, returns the member whose name matches <name> To this member, the following question can then be asked Null Handle if <name> not matched or <me> not a SELECT.
Remark : not to be asked for an entity type Hence, following IsInteger .. Enum* only apply on <me> and require Member While IsType applies on <me> and all Select Members

instanceMethods.name: IsInteger
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for an Integer.

instanceMethods.name: IsReal
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for a Real value.

instanceMethods.name: IsString
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for a String value.

instanceMethods.name: IsBoolean
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for a Boolean value (false,true).

instanceMethods.name: IsLogical
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for a Logical value (false,true,unknown).

instanceMethods.name: IsEnum
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for an Enum value Then, call AddEnumDef ordered from the first one (value 0) Managed by an EnumTool.

instanceMethods.name: EnumMax
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the maximum integer for a suitable value (count - 1).

instanceMethods.name: EnumValue

instanceMethods.name: EnumText

instanceMethods.name: IsEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for an Entity, either Described or CDL Type.

instanceMethods.name: IsType
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is for an entity of a given CDL type (early-bnd) (works for <me> + nexts if <me> is a Select).

instanceMethods.name: DescrName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the description (type name) to match, for a Described (else, empty string).

instanceMethods.name: Arity
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the arity of <me>.

instanceMethods.name: Simple
instanceMethods.comment: For a LIST or LIST OF LIST, Returns the PDescr for the simpler PDescr. Else, returns <me> This allows to have different attributes for Optional for instance, on a field, and on the parameter of a LIST : [OPTIONAL] LIST OF [OPTIONAL] ...

instanceMethods.name: IsOptional

instanceMethods.name: IsDerived
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if <me> is Derived.

instanceMethods.name: IsField

instanceMethods.name: Check

Semantic Check of a Field : does it complies with the given description ?
@returns A result object with fields:
- `ach`: owned by the returned envelope.
Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: CaseStep

Warning : For a Complex Type Entity, returns an Empty String (Complex Type must be managed by users).

instanceMethods.comment: Function specific to STEP. Some STEP Types have a short form This method can be redefined to fill it By default, returns an empty string, which is then interpreted to take normal form from StepType.

instanceMethods.name: ComplexType
instanceMethods.comment:
Function specific to STEP, which delivers the list of types which corresponds to a complex type. If <CN> is not for a complex type, this method returns False. Else it returns True and fills the list in alphabetic order. The default returns False. To be redefined as required.
@param types Mutated in place; read the updated value from this argument after the call.

instanceMethods.name: WriteStep
instanceMethods.signature: (CN: number, SW: StepData_StepWriter, ent: Standard_Transient): void
instanceMethods.comment: Write Function, switched by CaseNum.

classes.name: StepData_SelectInt
classes.summary: A SelectInt is a SelectMember specialised for a basic integer type in a select which also accepts entities : this one has NO NAME. For a named select, see SelectNamed.

instanceMethods.name: Int
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to read it).

classes.name: StepData_SelectMember
classes.summary:
The general form for a Select Member. A Select Member can, either define a value of a basic type (such as an integer) with an additional information : a name or list of names which precise the meaning of this value or be an alternate value in a select, which also accepts an entity (in this case, the name is not mandatory).
Several sub-types of SelectMember are defined for integer and real value, plus an "universal" one for any, and one more to describe a select with several names
It is also possible to define a specific subtype by redefining virtual method, then give a better control
Remark : this class itself could be deferred, because at least one of its virtual methods must be redefined to be usable

instanceMethods.name: HasName
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if a SelectMember has a name. Default is False.

instanceMethods.name: Name
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the name of a SelectMember. Default is empty.

instanceMethods.name: SetName
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the name of a SelectMember, returns True if done, False if no name is allowed Default does nothing and returns False.

instanceMethods.name: Matches
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if the name of a SelectMember matches a given one By default, compares the strings, can be redefined (optimised).

instanceMethods.name: ParamType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Kind of the SelectMember, under the form of an enum ParamType.

instanceMethods.name: Int
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to read it).

instanceMethods.name: SetInt
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to set it).

instanceMethods.name: Integer

classes.name: StepData_SelectNamed
classes.summary: This select member can be of any kind, and be named But its takes more memory than some specialised ones This class allows one name for the instance.

instanceMethods.name: HasName
instanceMethods.comment: Tells if a SelectMember has a name. Default is False.

instanceMethods.name: Name
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the name of a SelectMember. Default is empty.

instanceMethods.name: SetName
instanceMethods.comment: Sets the name of a SelectMember, returns True if done, False if no name is allowed Default does nothing and returns False.

instanceMethods.name: Int
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to read it).

instanceMethods.name: SetInt
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to set it).

classes.name: StepData_SelectReal
classes.summary: A SelectReal is a SelectMember specialised for a basic real type in a select which also accepts entities : this one has NO NAME For a named select, see SelectNamed.

classes.name: StepData_SelectType
classes.summary:
SelectType is the basis used for SELECT_TYPE definitions from the EXPRESS form. A SELECT_TYPE in EXPRESS is an enumeration of Types, it corresponds in a way to a Super-Type, but with no specific Methods, and no exclusivity (a given Type can be member of several SELECT_TYPES, plus be itself a SUB_TYPE).
A SelectType can be field of a Transient Entity or only used to control an input Argument
This class implies to designate each member Type by a Case Number which is a positive Integer value (this allows a faster treatment).
With this class, a specific SelectType can :
- recognize an Entity as complying or not with its definition,
- storing it, with the guarantee that the stored Entity complies with the definition of the SelectType
- and (if judged useful) give the stored Entity under the good Type rather than simply "Transient".

instanceMethods.name: CaseNum
instanceMethods.comment: Recognizes the Type of an Entity. Returns a positive Number which identifies the Type in the definition List of the SelectType. Returns Zero if its Type in not in this List.

instanceMethods.name: Matches
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if the Type of an Entity complies with the definition list of the SelectType. Also checks for a SelectMember Default Implementation looks for CaseNum or CaseMem positive.

instanceMethods.name: SetValue
instanceMethods.comment: Stores an Entity. This allows to define a specific SelectType class with one read method per member Type, which returns the Value casted with the good Type.

instanceMethods.name: Nullify
instanceMethods.comment: Nullifies the Stored Entity.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Stored Entity. Can be used to define specific read methods (see above).

instanceMethods.name: IsNull
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if there is no Stored Entity (i.e. it is Null).

instanceMethods.name: Type
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Effective (Dynamic) Type of the Stored Entity If it is Null, returns TYPE(Transient).

instanceMethods.name: CaseNumber
instanceMethods.comment: Recognizes the Type of the stored Entity, or zero if it is Null or SelectMember. Calls the first method CaseNum on Value.

instanceMethods.name: Description
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Description which corresponds to <me> Null if no specific description to give. This description is used to control reading an check validity. Default returns a Null Handle, i.e. undefined description It can suffice if CaseNum and CaseMem give enough control.

instanceMethods.name: NewMember
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns a preferred SelectMember. Default returns a Null By default, a SelectMember can be set according to data type and Name : it is a SelectNamed if Name is defined.
This method allows to define, for a specific SelectType, a specific SelectMember than SelectNamed. For instance for a Real plus a Name, a SelectReal plus a case number is a good solution, lighter than SelectNamed which is very multipurpose

instanceMethods.name: CaseMem
instanceMethods.comment: Recognize a SelectMember (kind, name). Returns a positive value which identifies the case in the List of immediate cases (distinct from the List of Entity Types). Zero if not recognizes Default returns 0, saying that no immediate value is allowed.

instanceMethods.name: CaseMember
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the Type of the stored SelectMember, or zero if it is Null or Entity. Calls the method CaseMem on Value.

instanceMethods.name: Member
instanceMethods.comment: Returns Value as a SelectMember. Null if not a SelectMember.

instanceMethods.name: SelectName
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type name of SelectMember. If no SelectMember or with no type name, returns an empty string To change it, pass through the SelectMember itself.

instanceMethods.name: Int
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to read it).

instanceMethods.name: SetInt
instanceMethods.comment: This internal method gives access to a value implemented by an Integer (to set it) : a SelectMember MUST ALREADY BE THERE !

instanceMethods.name: Integer
instanceMethods.comment: Gets the value as an Integer.

instanceMethods.name: SetInteger
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a new Integer value, with an optional type name Warning : If a SelectMember is already set, works on it : value and name must then be accepted by this SelectMember.

classes.name: StepData_Simple

instanceMethods.name: CFieldNum

instanceMethods.name: Fields

instanceMethods.name: CFields

classes.name: StepData_StepDumper
classes.summary:
Provides a way to dump entities processed through STEP, with these features :
- same form as for writing a STEP File (because it is clear and compact enough, even if the names of the fields do not appear) : thus, no additional resource is required
- possibility to look for an entity itself (only its Type or with its content), an entity and it shared items (one level) or all the entities its refers to, directly or recursively.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a StepDumper, able to work on a given StepModel (which defines the total scope for dumping entities) and a given Protocol from Step (which defines the authorized types to be dumped) <mode> commands what is to be displayed (number or label) 0 for number (and corresponding labels are displayed apart) 1 for label (and corresponding numbers are displayed apart) 2 for label without anymore.

instanceMethods.name: StepWriter
instanceMethods.comment: Gives an access to the tool which is used to work : this allow to acts on some parameters : Floating Format, Scopes ...

Gives access to.

instanceMethods.name: Entity

instanceMethods.name: GetFromAnother

instanceMethods.name: StringLabel

instanceMethods.name: SetSourceCodePage
instanceMethods.comment: Return the encoding of STEP file for converting names into UNICODE.

classes.name: StepData_StepReaderTool
classes.summary: Specific FileReaderTool for Step; works with FileReaderData provides references evaluation, plus access to literal data and specific methods defined by FileReaderTool Remarks : works with a ReaderLib to load Entities.

instanceMethods.name: Prepare
instanceMethods.comment: Bounds empty entities to records, works with a specific FileRecognizer, stored and later used in Recognize Works only on data entities (skips header) <optimize : same as above.

instanceMethods.signature: (num: number): { returnValue: boolean; ach: Interface_Check; ent: Standard_Transient; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.returnType: { returnValue: boolean; ach: Interface_Check; ent: Standard_Transient; [Symbol.dispose](): void }

recognizes records, by asking either ReaderLib (default) or FileRecognizer (if defined) to do so. <ach> is to call RecognizeByLib

instanceMethods.name: BeginRead
instanceMethods.comment: fills model's header; that is, gives to it Header entities and commands their loading. Also fills StepModel's Global Check from StepReaderData's GlobalCheck

instanceMethods.comment:
fills an entity, given record no; works by using a ReaderLib to load each entity, which must be a Transient Actually, returned value is True if no fail, False else

classes.name: StepData_StepWriter
classes.summary: manages atomic file writing, under control of StepModel (for general organisation of file) and each class of Transient (for its own parameters) : prepares text to be written then writes it A stream cannot be used because Step limits line length at 72 In more, a specific object offers more appropriate functions

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an empty StepWriter from a StepModel. The StepModel provides the Number of Entities, as identifiers for File.

instanceMethods.name: LabelMode
instanceMethods.comment: ModeLabel controls how to display entity ids : 0 (D) gives entity number in the model 1 gives the already recorded label (else, its number) Warning : conflicts are not controlled.

instanceMethods.name: TypeMode
instanceMethods.comment: TypeMode controls the type form to use : 0 (D) for normal long form 1 for short form (if a type name has no short form, normal long form is then used).

instanceMethods.name: FloatWriter
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the embedded FloatWriter, which controls sending Reals Use this method to access FloatWriter in order to consult or change its options (MainFormat, FormatForRange,ZeroSuppress), because it is returned as the address of its field.

instanceMethods.name: SetScope
instanceMethods.comment: Declares the Entity Number <numscope> to correspond to a Scope which contains the Entity Number <numin>. Several calls to the same <numscope> add Entities in this Scope, in this order. Error if <numin> is already declared in the Scope Warning : the declaration of the Scopes is assumed to be consistent, i.e. <numin> is not referenced from outside this Scope (not checked here).

instanceMethods.name: IsInScope
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if an Entity identified by its Number is in a Scope.

instanceMethods.name: SendModel
instanceMethods.comment: Sends the complete Model, included HEADER and DATA Sections Works with a WriterLib defined through a Protocol If <headeronly> is given True, only the HEADER Section is sent (used to Dump the Header of a StepModel).

instanceMethods.name: SendHeader
instanceMethods.comment: Begins model header.

instanceMethods.name: SendData
instanceMethods.comment: Begins data section; error if EndSec was not set.

instanceMethods.name: SendEntity
instanceMethods.comment: Send an Entity of the Data Section. If it corresponds to a Scope, also Sends the Scope information and contained Items.

instanceMethods.name: EndSec
instanceMethods.comment: sets end of section; to be done before passing to next one

instanceMethods.name: EndFile
instanceMethods.comment: sets end of file; error is EndSec was not set

instanceMethods.name: NewLine
instanceMethods.comment: flushes current line; if empty, flushes it (defines a new empty line) if evenempty is True; else, skips it

instanceMethods.name: JoinLast
instanceMethods.comment: joins current line to last one, only if new length is 72 max if newline is True, a new current line begins; else, current line is set to the last line (once joined) itself an can be completed

instanceMethods.name: Indent
instanceMethods.comment: asks that further indentations will begin at position of entity first opening bracket; else they begin at zero (def) for each sublist level, two more blancks are added at beginning (except for text continuation, which must begin at true zero)

instanceMethods.name: SendIdent
instanceMethods.comment: begins an entity with an ident plus '=' (at beginning of line) entity ident is its Number given by the containing Model Warning : <ident> must be, either Number or Label, according LabelMode

instanceMethods.name: SendScope
instanceMethods.comment: sets a begin of Scope (ends this line)

instanceMethods.name: SendEndscope
instanceMethods.comment: sets an end of Scope (on a separate line)

instanceMethods.name: Comment
instanceMethods.comment: sets a comment mark : if mode is True, begins Comment zone, if mode is False, ends Comment zone (if one is begun)

instanceMethods.name: SendComment
instanceMethods.comment: sends a comment. Error if we are not inside a comment zone

instanceMethods.name: SendComment
instanceMethods.comment: same as above but accepts a CString (ex.: "..." directly)

instanceMethods.name: StartEntity
instanceMethods.comment: sets entity's StepType, opens brackets, starts param no to 0 params are separated by comma Remark : for a Multiple Type Entity (see Express ANDOR clause) StartComplex must be called before sending components, then each "Component" must be sent separately (one call to StartEntity for each one) : the Type which precedes is then automatically closed. Once all the components have been sent, EndComplex must be called, then and only then EndEntity

instanceMethods.name: StartComplex
instanceMethods.comment: sends the start of a complex entity, which is a simple open bracket (without increasing bracket level) It must be called JUST AFTER SendEntity and BEFORE sending components, each one begins by StartEntity

instanceMethods.name: EndComplex
instanceMethods.comment: sends the end of a complex entity : a simple closed bracket It must be called AFTER sending all the components and BEFORE the final call to EndEntity

instanceMethods.name: SendField
instanceMethods.comment: Sends the content of a field, controlled by its descriptor If the descriptor is not defined, follows the description detained by the field itself.

instanceMethods.name: SendSelect
instanceMethods.comment: Sends a SelectMember, which cab be named or not.

instanceMethods.name: SendList
instanceMethods.comment: Send the content of an entity as being a FieldList controlled by its descriptor. This includes start and end brackets but not the entity type.

instanceMethods.name: OpenSub
instanceMethods.comment: open a sublist by a '('

instanceMethods.name: OpenTypedSub
instanceMethods.comment: open a sublist with its type then a '('

instanceMethods.name: CloseSub
instanceMethods.comment: closes a sublist by a ')'

instanceMethods.name: AddParam
instanceMethods.comment: prepares adding a parameter (that is, adds ',' except for first one); normally for internal use; can be used to send a totally empty parameter (with no literal value)

instanceMethods.name: Send
instanceMethods.comment: sends an integer parameter

instanceMethods.name: Send
instanceMethods.comment: sends a real parameter (works with FloatWriter)

instanceMethods.name: Send
instanceMethods.comment: sends a text given as string (it will be set between '...')

instanceMethods.name: Send
instanceMethods.comment: sends a reference to an entity (its identifier with '#') REMARK 1 : a Null <val> is interpreted as "Undefined" REMARK 2 : for an HAsciiString which is not recorded in the Model, it is send as its String Content, between quotes

instanceMethods.name: SendBoolean
instanceMethods.comment: sends a Boolean as .T. for True or .F. for False (it is an useful case of Enum, which is built-in)

instanceMethods.name: SendLogical
instanceMethods.comment: sends a Logical as .T. or .F. or .U. according its Value (it is a standard case of Enum for Step, and is built-in)

instanceMethods.name: SendString
instanceMethods.comment: sends a string exactly as it is given

instanceMethods.name: SendString
instanceMethods.comment: sends a string exactly as it is given

instanceMethods.name: SendEnum
instanceMethods.comment: sends an enum given by String (literal expression) adds '.' around it if not done Remark : val can be computed by class EnumTool from {@link StepData | `StepData`}: StepWriter.SendEnum (myenum.Text(enumval));

instanceMethods.name: SendEnum
instanceMethods.comment: sends an enum given by String (literal expression) adds '.' around it if not done

instanceMethods.name: SendArrReal
instanceMethods.comment: sends an array of real

instanceMethods.name: SendUndef
instanceMethods.comment: sends an undefined (optional absent) parameter (by '$')

instanceMethods.name: SendDerived
instanceMethods.comment: sends a "Derived" parameter (by '*'). A Derived Parameter has been inherited from a Super-Type then redefined as being computed by a function. Hence its value in file is senseless.

instanceMethods.name: EndEntity
instanceMethods.comment: sends end of entity (closing bracket plus ';') Error if count of opened-closed brackets is not null

instanceMethods.name: NbLines
instanceMethods.comment: Returns count of Lines.

instanceMethods.name: Line
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a Line given its rank in the File.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates an empty Library : it will later by filled by method AddProtocol.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a Library which complies with a Protocol, that is : Same class (criterium IsInstance) This creation gets the Modules from the global set, those which are bound to the given Protocol and its Resources.

staticMethods.name: SetGlobal
staticMethods.comment: Adds a couple (Module-Protocol) into the global definition set for this class of Library.

instanceMethods.name: AddProtocol
instanceMethods.comment: Adds a couple (Module-Protocol) to the Library, given the class of a Protocol. Takes Resources into account. (if <aprotocol> is not of type TheProtocol, it is not added).

instanceMethods.name: Clear

instanceMethods.name: SetComplete
instanceMethods.comment: Sets a library to be defined with the complete Global list (all the couples Protocol/Modules recorded in it).

instanceMethods.name: Select
instanceMethods.signature: (obj: Standard_Transient, CN: number): { returnValue: boolean; module_: StepData_ReadWriteModule; CN: number; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.returnType: { returnValue: boolean; module_: StepData_ReadWriteModule; CN: number; [Symbol.dispose](): void }
instanceMethods.comment:
Selects a Module from the Library, given an Object. Returns True if Select has succeeded, False else. Also Returns (as arguments) the selected Module and the Case Number determined by the associated Protocol. If Select has failed, <module> is Null Handle and CN is zero. (Select can work on any criterium, such as Object DynamicType).

- `module_`: owned by the returned envelope.

Dispose the returned envelope to release owned Handle fields.

instanceMethods.name: Start

instanceMethods.name: More

instanceMethods.name: Next

instanceMethods.name: Module
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current Module in the Iteration.

instanceMethods.name: Protocol
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current Protocol in the Iteration.
